messages:
Kayla: quick flag  the API ref for POST /v1/predict now uses `inputs: [{text: string}]` in OpenAPI but several curl/python/js examples still show `prompt: "..."`. customers are copy-pasting and getting 400s.
Miguel: thanks, noted. i'll open a draft PR to fix examples and add a migration note.
Sam: yup saw a support ticket earlier. proposal: canonical examples = `inputs` array, keep one legacy `prompt` example labelled DEPRECATED.
Priya: can add a short Go snippet that demonstrates batching (Inputs struct with json tags) and update Python/JS samples.
Tim: don't forget to run tools/docs-gen after changing openapi.yaml or CI will fail. add regen step to the PR checklist.
Miguel: PR draft: github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4491 (WIP). includes: updated openapi examples, regenerated artifacts, updated curl/py/js/go snippets, and a migration note.
Kayla: add an SSE example showing how to accumulate partial tokens across events; EventSource consumer needs to JSON.parse(event.data) and append deltas until final.
Priya: drafting SSE snippet now, will show code that collects `payload.delta_tokens` and emits final output on `payload.final`.
Miguel: added a tiny snapshot test for code-block rendering so formatting regressions fail CI early.
docs-bot: preview: https://deploy-preview-4491--docs.redwood.ai (note: mixed examples until docs-gen commit lands).
Sam: tagging reviewers: @Priya @Tim @DevEx. please try to review by EOD tomorrow.
Kayla: once merged i'll post a short note in #product-updates and schedule a deprecation blurb in release notes.
